what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20832 Afghan refugees in Sweden, 0.8% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1985 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Afghanistan from 2015 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 378 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 30546, at the end of 2019, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
